Celebrations

Soft oat clusters

Zabos toboz

12 months+ Replaced 25 min 8 portions

Occasional food from 12 months. If a cluster turns crisp, do not serve it. Offer wheat in ordinary pasta or bread through the week as well.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 1 ripe banana (mashed; no sugar and no chocolate)
  • 80 g rolled oats (soft clusters, not cornflakes or another hard cereal)
  • 1 tsp rapeseed or olive oil (keeps the clusters from drying)

Allergens

gluten

Method

  1. Mash the banana.
  2. Stir in the oats and oil until soft clusters hold together.
  3. Set small heaps on a tray.
  4. Bake at 160 C until just set and still soft.
  5. Cool them covered so they do not dry hard.
  6. Offer one soft cluster, with no chocolate and no crisp cereal.

Replaced

The usual pinecone biscuit is cornflakes and chocolate.

Make soft oat and banana clusters with no chocolate and no hard cereal. Keep them occasional.
